preconditions.name: wl_instrument_positive_control_separates
preconditions.description: leg 1: a constructed 2-token IncentiveTokenBank (this run's GoalConfig) yields a drive-favored most-wanted that DIFFERS from a designated last-consumed type -- the SAME cross-target inequality statistic C_WL routes on, on a positive control.
preconditions.control: 2 deterministic probes: drive-favored most-wanted vs designated last-consumed (instrument-can-fire).

preconditions.name: run_bank_populated_two_tokens_differing_drive
preconditions.description: leg 2: per guard-passing seed the behavioural run's bank reached >= 2 distinct object tokens AND scored >= MIN_SCORED_STEPS consumption events (info consumed tag > 0) with both targets defined AND per-axis-drive spread > floor (channels-written-this-run -- the exact 514n n_scored=0 gap).
preconditions.control: fraction of guard-passing seeds with a populated, drive-differentiated bank at consumption events.

contact_guard.definition: per-seed: P2 contact_rate > 0 AND z_goal_norm_at_contact_peak > 0.4 (603n G2 + G3). A seed failing the guard is excluded from DV aggregation; < 2/3 seeds passing -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a false weakens. 603n itself cleared G3 only 2/3; the leg is substrate-marginal (~0.4 +- noise, env layout default_rng(None)).

wl_readiness_gate.definition: SAME-STATISTIC non-vacuity for the WL DV (the 514m/514n gap fix): leg 1 positive-control cross-target separation >= 1.0 AND leg 2 in-run bank populated >= 2 distinct tokens at differing per-axis drives on >= 2/3 guard-passing seeds. Below floor -> substrate_not_ready_requeue (non_contributory), NEVER a false MECH-229 weakens.

drive_dependence_control.definition: WL_nodrive (drive-uniform most-wanted, per_axis_drive=None) is the within-eval drive-dependence control: a genuine MECH-229 drive-coupled dissociation has WL_drive >> WL_nodrive. Reported as the diagnostic wl_drive_minus_nodrive; not a load-bearing gate this run.

falsifier_offramp.definition: Pre-registered Woo/Spelke off-ramp (substrate_queue SD-049-PHASE-2 row-6). If (a)+(b) met but (c) FAILs (genuine weakens), the disambiguating follow-on is an OFF/control arm (SD-049 identity / bank disabled -> wanting structurally == liking -> WL ~ 0) AND an OVERSHOOT arm (n_resource_types=5). JOINT failure across the SD-049-on AND overshoot arms routes MECH-229 -> substrate_conditional with a V4-1 multi-agent-ecology dependency (clean exit). This run is the SD-049-on arm; off/control + overshoot are queued only on a genuine weakens here.
